notes:
Faster app and tab pickup on macOS; a cuter mascot that walks in from the screen edge

- macOS: take the frontmost app from the window server's stacking order; NSWorkspace's
  frontmostApplication lagged behind on the agent's worker thread.
- Re-read a browser's URL every tick when there's no window title to notice tab switches by.
- The mascot is a rounder penguin with the Kairos mark on its belly. It walks in from the nearer
  screen edge, floats above other apps on macOS, and the window closes when it pecks the button
  rather than after a fixed delay.
